script.base: Patriots are -12.5 at home with implied totals NE 28.0 / NYJ 15.5 on a 43.5 total, so the book has NE leading by halftime and pulling away. With Stevenson out, Henderson (38 carries, 277 rush yards over weeks 8-10) is the clock-killing back; Maye has been fine in structure (EPA/db +0.50 vs the blitz, and NYJ blitzes 31%). Jets fall behind, pass rate rises on a Wilson-less group that has not been efficient (Mason Taylor 15 targets / 69 yards in weeks 7/8/10), and Hall's rush volume is the piece that dies late. Blowout flag: NE WR snaps at risk after the lead is safe. Weather not saved.
script.flip1: Game stays within one score into the fourth. Hall (50/254 L3) and Fields (19/84 L3) keep NYJ on schedule, NE never gets the pure run-out, Henderson's carry spike is smaller, and Diggs/Hollins/Douglas stay on the field. Hall rush 81.5 stays alive; deep NE receiving is the flip winner.
script.flip2: Shootout or a Jets explosive pass day: NE has allowed 35 gains of 20+ and 7.1-7.5 YPA to every side of the field, so Taylor/Reynolds air yards and Hollins/Douglas correlate over and the run-clock stack dies. Opposite slog: unknown November night weather plus both fronts drag 43.5 under and compress efficiency, though Henderson 27.5 only needs a short day.

injury_fallout: Official pre-game report only (nflverse); no DNP/limited/full practice trend and no 90-minute inactives. OUT NE: Hooper (TE, concussion), Elliss (LB, hip), Stevenson (RB, toe), Boutte (WR, hamstring). OUT NYJ: Wilson (WR, knee), Thomas (CB, concussion). Q unresolved: Jennings (RB, knee), Farmer (DT, ankle), Phillips (DT, foot), Herbert (RB, groin), Newman-Johnson (G, ankle), McDonald (DE, quad), McGregor (DE, shoulder). Gains: Henderson already has the lead share (38/277 L3) and Stevenson's 14 L3 carries are up for grabs; Gibson was not in the weeks 8-10 rush log, so he only gains if the Stevenson absence reactivates him. Henry is already the TE1 (11 targets / 67 yards L3) and Hooper's 4/58 is a small add, not a new role. Hollins (19/204), Douglas (9/178) and Diggs (17/98) split Boutte's 6/75. Thomas out is general help for NE WRs; Elliss out is general help for NYJ TE/RB receiving (Taylor, Hall, Davis). Loses: the five outs have no snaps. Hall's efficiency expectation falls into NE's 3.86 YPC defense even if his Wilson-less carry share (already the L3 sample; Wilson is absent from the weeks 7/8/10 target list) holds. If Newman-Johnson sits, Jets rush efficiency drops and quick throws rise. If McDonald/McGregor sit, NYJ pressure (already a bad idea vs Maye) gets lighter.

NE pass defense is evenly ordinary (left 7.54/134, middle 7.2/74, right 7.1/122) with 35 explosives of 20+.

Hall, the Jets' primary touch piece, runs into the opposite (NE 3.86 YPC). No named primary corner. Thomas out helps NE WRs generally; Elliss out helps Taylor/Hall/Davis in the short/middle area, which is not where NYJ's pass defense bleeds.

pre_mortem: It's Monday and Henderson under 27.5 is the side that won. The role never showed up: Jennings played through the knee tag and Gibson, buried in weeks 8-10, took Stevenson's 14 carries, and Henderson repeated the 5-yard game in the last four. Or NYJ jumped ahead, Maye threw the game away from the run, and a healthy Phillips front held a committee under 4 yards a carry. A fourth-quarter blowout sit does not explain a miss of 27.5 unless the carries never came in the first three quarters. The operational miss is just as real: 27.5 may be a season-median stand-in with no live price, so there was never a number to bet. That counter is not stronger than the role-plus-script-plus-4.81-YPC read if a real line is still 27.5; it is stronger as a reason not to stake anything today.
slip_story: One script only: Patriots lead and run the clock. Henderson rush over is the anchor and the only leg that survived the pre-mortem. The correlate that belongs on this story, Hall rush under, was dropped as a lean the recent form does not confirm. Hollins and Douglas overs need the pass-volume flip and are not on this slip. No TDs, no receptions, no second market on Henderson. Not a 3-4 leg slip because no second available prop cleared the checklist.
